overview_description.description: Braveheart Bio is a biotechnology startup in late clinical development, working on innovative treatments for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and related disorders. Braveheart's small molecule therapy candidate, BHB-1893, is a selective cardiac myosin inhibitor designed to improve heart function in HCM patients. Overcontraction in HCM can result in thicker heart muscle and a decline in the heart's ability to fill and pump blood. HCM is among the most frequent uncommon diseases, affecting one in every 500 people in the United States.
